name: "Kareshi Inai Reki = Nenrei" Ja, Doushite Ikenai no yo!? ~Sei Torea Gakuen Ren'ai Kinshi Rei~
original_name: 『彼氏いない歴＝年齢』じゃ、どうしてイケナイのよ!? ～聖トレア学園恋愛禁止令～
source:
This sex-packed eroge by Hadashi Shoujo stars a cast of girls who are desperate for loving but unable to find a man due to their eccentricities, much like the girls in popular anime Haganai, so they decide to punish happy couples in erotic fashion. 

[From J-List]
